versions.changelog: v1.1.0: ledger context on unverified orders, raw API positions
Circuit breaker integration - warns when API data contradicts known state
Fix portfolio API empty response crash
fix: Kalshi API v3 field normalization (yes_bid_dollars to cents)
Fix v3 API field names: event_positions + position_fp

Initial release: Complete Kalshi trading interface with portfolio, market scanning, risk management, and trade execution.

- Portfolio and open positions with real-time P&L and emoji indicators.
- Live scanning of 600+ markets, edge scoring, and custom blocklists.
- Market data queries, order management, and intelligent trade execution with Kelly sizing.
- Built-in safety: $25 max trade, 100 contract cap, $50 daily loss cutoff.
- Supports integration with OpenClaw agent stack and Market Morning Brief.
- Caching for research opportunities, audit logging, and full risk validation workflow.
